definitions.explanation: Describes an appliance or device that performs only one function, in contrast to a multifunctional model. Commonly used for kitchen appliances — a microwave that only heats, a printer that only prints, etc. Frequently used as a noun modifier with の.

examples.japanese: {単機能|たんきのう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電子|でんし}レンジ→電子レンジ：04973_denshirenji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{単機能|たんきのう}⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧だ。
examples.english: Single-function appliances are easy to operate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{多機能|たきのう}→多機能：18683_takinou⟧⟦{機種|きしゅ}→機種：13211_kishu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えたい→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単機能|たんきのう}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧だ。
examples.english: Multifunctional models are expensive, so for those looking to keep costs down, a single-function type is recommended.

notes:
Compound of {単|たん} (single) + ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧ (function). The direct antonym is ⟦{多機能|たきのう}→多機能：18683_takinou⟧ (multifunctional), and the two are routinely contrasted in product descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単機能|たんきのう}⟦{電子|でんし}レンジ→電子レンジ：04973_denshirenji⟧: single-function microwave (heating only)
- {単機能|たんきのう}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧: single-function type
- {単機能|たんきのう}⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧: single-function home appliance
- {単機能|たんきのう}⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧: basic / single-function model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多機能|たきのう}→多機能：18683_takinou⟧: multifunctional (antonym)
- ⟦シンプル→シンプル：10943_shinpuru⟧: simple — overlaps in nuance but is broader
- ベーシック: basic — a marketing-flavored loanword used the same way
